passages.text: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he set out with his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Jacob, also called Israel.
Joseph lived in Egypt.
Jacob was old and near death.
Someone told Joseph, “Your father is sick.”
Joseph took his two sons with him.
Joseph’s sons were Manasseh and Ephraim.
Joseph went to see his father.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְיוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יךָ חֹלֶ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֤י בָנָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was very old and weak.
Someone told Jacob, “Your son Joseph is coming to you.”
Jacob is also called Israel.
Israel gathered his strength.
Israel sat up in his bed.
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה בִּנְךָ֥ יוֹסֵ֖ף בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיִּתְחַזֵּק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ הַמִּטָּֽה׃

passages.text: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there He blessed me and told me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you; I will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Joseph.
Jacob was Joseph’s father.
Jacob said, “God Almighty appeared to me.
God appeared to me at Luz.
Luz is in the land of Canaan.
God blessed me there.
God said to me, ‘I will make you fruitful.
I will multiply you.
I will make you into a community of peoples.
I will give this land to your descendants after you.
Your descendants will have this land as an everlasting possession.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֥ל שַׁדַּ֛י נִרְאָֽה־ אֵלַ֥י בְּל֖וּז בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתִֽי׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הִנְנִ֤י מַפְרְךָ֙ וְהִרְבִּיתִ֔ךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לִקְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְנָ֨תַתִּ֜י אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Joseph.
Jacob was Joseph’s father.
Joseph was living in Egypt.
Joseph had two sons in Egypt before Jacob arrived.
These two sons are Ephraim and Manasseh.
Jacob said, “Ephraim and Manasseh are now mine.”
Jacob counted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons.
Jacob said, “Ephraim and Manasseh will be to me like Reuben and Simeon.”
Reuben and Simeon were Jacob’s first two sons.
Jacob gave Ephraim and Manasseh the same status as Reuben and Simeon.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְׁנֵֽי־ בָנֶיךָ֩ הַנּוֹלָדִ֨ים לְךָ֜ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־ בֹּאִ֥י אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצְרַ֖יְמָה לִי־ הֵ֑ם אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וּמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּרְאוּבֵ֥ן וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן יִֽהְיוּ־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: Any children born to you after them shall be yours, and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit.
passages.sermon:
Any children born to you after Ephraim and Manasseh will belong to you.
These later children will not be counted as mine.
They will be called by the names of their brothers.
They will receive their inheritance within the territory of their brothers.
passages.original: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹלַ֥דְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם לְךָ֣ יִהְי֑וּ עַ֣ל שֵׁ֧ם אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יִקָּרְא֖וּ בְּנַחֲלָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Now as for me, when I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died along the way in the land of Canaan, some distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath” (that is, Bethlehem).
passages.sermon:
Jacob is the father of Joseph.
Jacob speaks about his wife Rachel.
Jacob says he was returning from Paddan.
Rachel died while they traveled.
They were in the land of Canaan.
Rachel died on the way.
They were still some distance from Ephrath.
Jacob buried Rachel there.
He buried her beside the road to Ephrath.
Ephrath is also called Bethlehem.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֣י׀ בְּבֹאִ֣י מִפַּדָּ֗ן מֵ֩תָה֩ עָלַ֨י רָחֵ֜ל בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֙עַן֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת־ אֶ֖רֶץ לָבֹ֣א אֶפְרָ֑תָה וָאֶקְבְּרֶ֤הָ שָּׁם֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔ת הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”
passages.sermon:
Israel was old.
Israel could hardly see.
Israel saw Joseph’s sons.
Israel asked, “Who are these?”
passages.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Joseph said to his father, “They are the sons God has given me in this place.” So Jacob said, “Please bring them to me, that I may bless them.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his father Jacob.
Joseph said, “These are my sons.”
God gave these sons to me here in Egypt.
Jacob said, “Bring your sons to me.”
Jacob said, “I want to bless them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֔יו בָּנַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נָֽתַן־ לִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּזֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמַ֕ר קָֽחֶם־ נָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וַאֲבָרֲכֵֽם׃

passages.text: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. Joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
passages.sermon:
Israel was very old.
His eyesight was weak.
He could not see well.
Joseph brought his sons to Israel.
Israel kissed his grandsons.
Israel hugged them.
passages.original: וְעֵינֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כָּבְד֣וּ מִזֹּ֔קֶן לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְא֑וֹת וַיַּגֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּשַּׁ֥ק לָהֶ֖ם וַיְחַבֵּ֥ק לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “I never expected to see your face again,” Israel said to Joseph, “but now God has let me see your children as well.”
passages.sermon:
Israel was Joseph’s father.
Israel spoke to Joseph.
Israel said, “I did not expect to see you again.”
God has allowed me to see you.
God has also allowed me to see your children.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף רְאֹ֥ה פָנֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א פִלָּ֑לְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֨ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י אֱלֹהִ֖ים גַּ֥ם אֶת־ זַרְעֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Israel.
Joseph had two sons.
Joseph’s father was Israel.
Joseph’s sons were near Israel’s knees.
Joseph took his sons away from Israel’s knees.
Joseph bowed down with his face to the ground.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֹתָ֖ם מֵעִ֣ם בִּרְכָּ֑יו וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְאַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: And Joseph took both of them—with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand—and brought them close to him.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Israel.
Ephraim and Manasseh were Joseph’s sons.
Joseph took both of his sons.
He took Ephraim in his right hand.
He placed Ephraim toward Israel’s left hand.
He took Manasseh in his left hand.
He placed Manasseh toward Israel’s right hand.
Joseph brought both sons close to Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח יוֹסֵף֮ אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶם֒ אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֤יִם בִּֽימִינוֹ֙ מִשְּׂמֹ֣אל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בִשְׂמֹאל֖וֹ מִימִ֣ין יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּגֵּ֖שׁ אֵלָֽיו׃

passages.text: But Israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger; and crossing his hands, he put his left on Manasseh’s head, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
passages.sermon:
Israel was Joseph’s father.
Israel had two grandsons before him.
Ephraim was the younger grandson.
Manasseh was the older grandson.
Israel stretched out his right hand.
He placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head.
He stretched out his left hand.
He placed his left hand on Manasseh’s head.
Israel crossed his hands on purpose.
Manasseh was the firstborn son.
Israel put his right hand on the younger son, Ephraim.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־ יְמִינ֜וֹ וַיָּ֨שֶׁת עַל־ רֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְה֣וּא הַצָּעִ֔יר וְאֶת־ שְׂמֹאל֖וֹ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שִׂכֵּל֙ אֶת־ יָדָ֔יו כִּ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַבְּכֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Then he blessed Joseph and said: “May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day, the angel who has redeemed me from all harm— may He bless these boys. And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob was Joseph’s father.
Jacob spoke a blessing over Joseph.
Jacob said, “May God bless these boys.”
Abraham and Isaac were Jacob’s fathers before him.
Abraham and Isaac walked with God.
God has been my shepherd all my life.
God has cared for me from my youth until today.
The angel has saved me from all harm.
May this same God bless these boys.
May these boys be called by my name.
May they also be called by the names of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac.
May these boys grow and become many on the earth.
passages.original: וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ אֲבֹתַ֤י לְפָנָיו֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְיִצְחָ֔ק הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ הָרֹעֶ֣ה אֹתִ֔י מֵעוֹדִ֖י עַד־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ הַמַּלְאָךְ֩ הַגֹּאֵ֨ל אֹתִ֜י מִכָּל־ רָ֗ע יְבָרֵךְ֮ אֶת־ הַנְּעָרִים֒ וְיִקָּרֵ֤א בָהֶם֙ שְׁמִ֔י וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲבֹתַ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְיִצְחָ֑ק וְיִדְגּ֥וּ לָרֹ֖ב בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, he was displeased and took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
Jacob was also called Israel.
Ephraim and Manasseh were Joseph’s sons.
Ephraim was the younger son.
Manasseh was the firstborn son.
Jacob put his right hand on Ephraim’s head.
Joseph saw this.
Joseph did not like it.
Joseph took his father’s hand.
Joseph tried to move his father’s hand from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּי־ יָשִׁ֨ית אָבִ֧יו יַד־ יְמִינ֛וֹ עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַיֵּ֣רַע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וַיִּתְמֹ֣ךְ יַד־ אָבִ֗יו לְהָסִ֥יר אֹתָ֛הּ מֵעַ֥ל רֹאשׁ־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his father.
Joseph said, “No, my father.”
Joseph said, “This one is the firstborn.”
Joseph said, “Put your right hand on his head.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו לֹא־ כֵ֣ן אָבִ֑י כִּי־ זֶ֣ה הַבְּכֹ֔ר שִׂ֥ים יְמִינְךָ֖ עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: But his father refused. “I know, my son, I know!” he said. “He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob was Joseph’s father.
Jacob refused Joseph’s request.
Jacob said, “I know, my son. I know.”
Jacob said, “Manasseh will also become a people.”
Jacob said, “Manasseh will also be great.”
Jacob said, “But his younger brother will be greater than he.”
Jacob said, “The younger brother’s descendants will become a multitude of nations.”
passages.original: וַיְמָאֵ֣ן אָבִ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יָדַ֤עְתִּֽי בְנִי֙ יָדַ֔עְתִּי גַּם־ ה֥וּא יִֽהְיֶה־ לְּעָ֖ם וְגַם־ ה֣וּא יִגְדָּ֑ל וְאוּלָ֗ם אָחִ֤יו הַקָּטֹן֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְזַרְע֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מְלֹֽא־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: So that day Jacob blessed them and said: “By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’ ” So he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of Joseph.
\r\nJacob blessed Joseph’s sons on that day.
\r\nJacob spoke a blessing over them.
\r\nJacob said, “Israel will use you as a blessing.”
\r\nJacob said, “May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.”
\r\nJacob placed Ephraim before Manasseh.
passages.original: וַיְבָ֨רֲכֵ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמוֹר֒ בְּךָ֗ יְבָרֵ֤ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְשִֽׂמְךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כְּאֶפְרַ֖יִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לִפְנֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
passages.sermon:
Israel was Joseph’s father.
Israel spoke to Joseph.
Israel said, “I am about to die.”
God will be with you.
God will bring you back to the land of your fathers.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וְהָיָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And to you, as one who is above your brothers, I give the ridge of land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Joseph.
Jacob was the father of Joseph.
Jacob said, “I give you a special portion of land.
This land is above what your brothers receive.
I took this land from the Amorites.
I used my sword and my bow to take it.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּֽי לְךָ֛ שְׁכֶ֥ם אַחַ֖ד עַל־ אַחֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ מִיַּ֣ד הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י בְּחַרְבִּ֖י וּבְקַשְׁתִּֽי׃פ
